intents.name: banking_products
intents.answer:
🏦 *Meridian Bank — Products*

• *Savings Accounts:* Zero-balance option for salary accounts. Regular savings requires ₹5,000 monthly average balance (MAB). Digital account opens in ~10 mins with PAN & Aadhaar.
• *Current Accounts:* For businesses & professionals with cheque book, net banking, and overdraft facilities.

_Interested in applying? Select 'Check Eligibility' or 'Request Callback' below._

intents.name: cards
intents.answer:
💳 *Meridian Bank — Cards*

• *Debit Cards:* Free with savings accounts, contactless, with configurable daily limits via our app.
• *Credit Cards:* Travel, cashback, and secured (FD-backed) card variants available.
• *Activation:* Set your PIN at any Meridian ATM or activate instantly via the mobile app.
• *Lost/Stolen Card:* Block immediately in the app or call 1800 123 4567 (24x7).

intents.name: loans
intents.answer:
💰 *Meridian Bank — Loan Options*

• *Home Loans:* Up to 80% property value funding with tenures up to 30 years.
• *Personal Loans:* Quick sanction for salaried & self-employed; tenures up to 5 years.
• *Vehicle Loans:* Up to 90% on-road funding for new four-wheelers & two-wheelers.
• *Education Loans:* Collateral-free options available for premier institutes.

_Tap 'Check Eligibility' below to see if you qualify in under 1 minute!_

intents.name: check_eligibility
intents.answer:
📊 *Meridian Bank — Eligibility Criteria*

• *Personal Loans:* Age 21–58, minimum monthly net salary ₹25,000, CIBIL score 700+.
• *Home Loans:* Age 21–65, minimum household income ₹35,000/mo, up to 80% property value funding.
• *Vehicle Loans:* Age 21–60, minimum income ₹20,000/mo, up to 90% on-road funding.
• *Credit Cards:* Minimum age 21, regular income ₹20,000/mo or secured against Fixed Deposit (FD).

_Tap *'Check Eligibility'* in the menu to check your pre-qualification!_
